sentence: Imini yonke ndisebenza egadini, ndiphumla kuphela xa ilanga litshona.

sentence: Unyana wam wenze ikrele ngeplanga, udlala imfazwe egadini imini yonke.

sentence: Isithunywa sankqonkqoza emnyango ngokuhlwa, sifuna ukubona umninimzi ngokukhawuleza.

sentence: Ikomkhulu lithumele isithunywa ukuze sazise abantu ngentlanganiso yangomso.

sentence: Ubawo uvuka ngentsimbi yesine, aze enze itiye phambi kokuba sivuke.

sentence: Ndiyamkhumbula ubawo kakhulu, ingakumbi xa ndisiva iingoma awayezithanda.

sentence: Ndasika isonka ndaqaba ibhotolo, ndilungiselela abantwana isidlo sakusasa.

sentence: Ngexesha lekhefu emsebenzini sitya isonka netiye, sincokola ngebhola.

sentence: Isonka esishushu sisandikhumbuza umakhulu owayesibhaka ngeziko yonke imihla.

sentence: Ubhuti wam wajoyina umkhosi, kwaye usibhalela iileta qho ngenyanga.

sentence: Umkhosi umise iintente ngaphandle kwedolophu, amajoni elinde imiyalelo.

sentence: Ndicinga ukuba umkhosi ufanele ukunceda abantu ngexesha lezikhukula, kungekhona ukulwa kuphela.

sentence: Ndihlamba iingubo kanye ngeveki, ngoMgqibelo xa ndingayi emsebenzini.

sentence: Intlanganiso yabazali ibanjwa kanye ngekota, ngoko sonke sizama ukuya.

sentence: Ndaya elwandle kanye kuphela ebomini bam, kodwa andisoze ndiyilibale loo mini.

sentence: NgoMgqibelo kusasa abafazi bahlamba iimpahla emlanjeni, bencokola ngabantwana babo.

sentence: Abafazi belali bahlanganise imali yokwakha ivenkile encinci ecaleni kwendlela.

sentence: Utata uthi abafazi babesoloko bebamba ikhaya xa amadoda esemgodini.

sentence: Ewe, ndiyibonile imali oyishiye etafileni, ndaza ndayibeka ebhokisini.

sentence: Izulu lisibekele ukusukela kusasa, ngoko sishiye iimpahla ngaphakathi endlwini.

sentence: Abalimi bakhangela izulu yonke intsasa, belindele imvula engekafiki nangoku.

sentence: Ixesha lokutya lifika ngentsimbi yesithandathu, ngoko umama uqala ukupheka ngoku.

sentence: Ndihamba ngeenyawo ukuya esikolweni kuba iteksi ibiza kakhulu.

sentence: Ikhaya lithi cwaka xa abantwana behamba, kodwa umsebenzi usedolophini.

sentence: Umama wabeka indlebe emnyango, efuna ukuva ukuba abantwana balele na.

sentence: Ndiphuma ekhaya ngentsimbi yesithandathu ukuze ndifike emsebenzini ngexesha.

sentence: Umama wabhaka izonka ezithandathu ngoMgqibelo, saza sazithengisa kubamelwane bethu.

sentence: Abafundi bema bathi cwaka, bacula umhobe wesizwe phambi kokungena eklasini.

sentence: Kwibala lemidlalo, isihlwele sonke sasukuma xa umhobe wesizwe uqala.

sentence: Ndabeka itafile ngakwelinye icala legumbi ukuze kubekho indawo yokudlala.

sentence: Umakhi undixelele ukuba icala lasemva lendlu lifuna udonga olutsha.

sentence: Kule ngxabano, ndithatha icala likamama kuba ebenyanisile kwasekuqaleni.

sentence: Ndanika inja amathambo enkuku, yaza yawahlafuna phantsi kwetafile ubusuku bonke.

sentence: Emva kokusebenza emasimini imini yonke, amathambo am ayaqaqamba ebusuku.

sentence: Umakhulu wandinika icebo elihle malunga nendlela yokupheka umngqusho ngaphandle kwenyama.

sentence: Ngomso umakhulu ufika ngebhasi yaseGqeberha, ngoko kufuneka sicoce indlu namhlanje.

sentence: Usodolophu wenza intetho ende embhiyozweni, kwaza kwana imvula phakathi kwayo.

sentence: Ndayilibala intetho endandiyilungiselele emtshatweni kadade wethu, ndaza ndakhala.

sentence: Intetho yale nkokeli yandivuselela ithemba, nangona ndandingamthembi ngaphambili.

sentence: Esiya situlo sasekhitshini sophukile, ngoko utata uza kusilungisa ngempelaveki.

sentence: Andisithandi esiya sitya esikhulu; ndikhetha esi sincinci sikamakhulu.

sentence: Ithole lazalwa ebusuku ebuhlanti, laza lamunya ubisi lukanina ekuseni.

sentence: Ithole elincinci landilandela endleleni yonke, ndaza ndaqonda ukuba lilambile.

sentence: Umntwana uphuma ebhafini abaleke ze endlwini yonke, umama emsukela ngetawuli.

sentence: Amakhwenkwe ayequbha ze emlanjeni de abone utitshala esiza.

sentence: Ndaphupha ndihamba ze esitalatweni esixakekileyo, ndavuka ndibila ngamanzi.

sentence: Isilivere sikamakhulu sihleli ekhabhathini unyaka wonke, sikhutshwa kuphela ngeKrisimesi.

sentence: Ndikhetha isilivere kunegolide, kuba sihamba nayo yonke into endiyinxibayo.

sentence: Ehlotyeni sitya isidlo sangokuhlwa phandle phantsi komthi, kushushu endlwini.

sentence: Igumbi lokufundela lishushu kakhulu, ngoko utitshala uqhuba iklasi phandle.

sentence: Xa ndikhathazwa ziingcinga, ndiphuma ndihambe phandle de ndizole.

sentence: Iliso lam ladumba emva kokulunywa yinyosi egadini kamakhulu.

sentence: Umphathi ubeka iliso kubasebenzi abatsha kwiiveki zabo zokuqala.

sentence: Ndabona iliso likatata ligcwala iinyembezi xa sithetha ngomakhulu.

sentence: Inkulu yasekhaya kufuneka ijonge abantwana abancinane xa abazali bengekho.

sentence: Emngcwabeni katata, kwafuneka inkulu ithethe egameni losapho lonke.

sentence: Inkulu ithwala uxanduva lwekhaya lonke, kodwa akukho mntu ubulelayo.

sentence: Ubunzima bale ngxowa yempuphu bundenza ndime kathathu endleleni eya ekhaya.

sentence: Umqhubi uthe ubunzima belori bugqithile kumlinganiselo ovunyelweyo, kufuneka sikhuphe iingxowa.

sentence: Ekliniki bathe ubunzima bomntwana wam bunyuka kakuhle, ndaphefumla ngoxolo.

sentence: Ummelwane wethu usinika amaqanda qho ngeveki, thina simnika imifuno yasegadini.
translation: Our neighbour gives us eggs every week, and we give her vegetables from the garden.

sentence: Xa sisiya emsebenzini, ummelwane uhlala nabantwana bethu de sibuye.

sentence: Ummelwane wam uvula umculo ngokuvakalayo ebusuku, ndide ndingalali.
translation: My neighbour turns the music up loud at night, to the point where I get no sleep.

sentence: Ixabiso lesonka lishumi leerandi ngoku, ngoko sithenga esinye kuphela ngosuku.

sentence: Inani labafundi abafikileyo namhlanje lishumi, abanye bathintelwe yimvula.

sentence: Ixesha lokulinda ibhasi lishumi lemizuzu, kodwa kubanda ngathi ziiyure.

sentence: Imithi endayityalayo egadini ikhulile, ngoku sihlala emthunzini wayo ehlotyeni.
translation: The trees I planted in the garden have grown, and now we sit in their shade in summer.

sentence: Umasipala ugawula imithi emidala esitalatweni kuba iwisa amasebe ezindlwini.

sentence: Ndikhathazekile kuba imithi yakwaMakhulu yomile emva kwembalela ende.

sentence: Emva kokuba abantwana belele, kuthi cwaka endlwini ndikwazi ukufunda incwadi yam.

sentence: Kwathi cwaka eholweni xa intombazana encinci iqala ukucula.

sentence: Xa ndibuza ngotata wam, kuthi cwaka etafileni, akukho mntu ondijongayo.
translation: When I ask about my father, silence falls over the table and nobody will look at me.

sentence: Obo busuku bemvula asilalanga, silinde utata owayengekafiki ekhaya.
translation: That rainy night none of us slept, waiting for Dad, who still hadn't come home.

sentence: Obo buchule bokuluka bufundiswa ngoomakhulu kuphela, hayi ezikolweni.

sentence: Obo bomi basedolophini bundidinisa kakhulu, ndifuna ukubuyela emaXhoseni.
translation: That city life wears me right out; I want to go back to the Xhosa countryside.

sentence: Ulwimi lwam lwatsha xa ndandisitya isidudu esishushu kakhulu kusasa.
translation: I burnt my tongue this morning eating porridge that was far too hot.

sentence: Emsebenzini kufuneka usebenzise ulwimi lwesiXhosa xa uthetha nabathengi bethu.

sentence: Ulwimi lwenkobe lufa kancinci xa abantwana bengasaluthethi ekhaya nasezitratweni.

sentence: Izenzo zabantwana bam ekhaya zibonisa kakuhle into esibafundise yona.

sentence: Inkokeli yethu ithembisa kakhulu, kodwa izenzo zayo azihambelani namazwi ayo.
translation: Our leader promises a great deal, but her actions don't match her words.

sentence: Izenzo zobubele zikamakhulu zandifundisa ukuba ubuntu abuthengwa ngamali.
translation: My grandmother's acts of kindness taught me that decency cannot be bought with money.

sentence: Umntwana wam uzoba iinkomo zikatatomkhulu kuzo zonke iincwadi zesikolo.
translation: My child draws his grandfather's cattle on every page of his school books.

sentence: Kwiklasi yobugcisa, sizoba imephu yelali yethu ebonisa iindlela nomlambo.
translation: In the art class we are drawing a map of our village showing the roads and the river.

sentence: Xa ndikhathazekile ndizoba ubuso bukamakhulu, kuba oko kuzolisa intliziyo yam.
translation: When I'm troubled I draw my grandmother's face, because it settles my heart.

sentence: Udonga lwegumbi lam luvuza amanzi emva kwemvula enkulu yayizolo.
translation: The wall of my room is seeping water after yesterday's heavy rain.

sentence: Abafundi bebanga lesibhozo balupeyinte udonga lwesikolo ngamabala akhanyayo.
translation: The grade-eight learners have painted the school wall in bright colours.

sentence: Udonga olutsha lwabamelwane lusivalele ilanga, ngoku igadi yethu ayikhuli.

sentence: Umama ubhala amagama ethu onke ezimpahleni zesikolo ngaphambi kokuqala konyaka.

sentence: Kwintlanganiso yelali unobhala wafunda amagama abantu abafumene izindlu ezintsha.

sentence: Amagama omthandazo kamakhulu asenkumbulweni yam nangoku, nangona wandishiya kudala.

sentence: Utata wafaka umqondiso wesilumkiso esangweni lethu, kuba inja yethu iyaluma.

sentence: Emsebenzini umqondiso obomvu uthetha ukuba akukho mntu ufanele angene kwelo gumbi.

sentence: Kutata, umqondiso wothando awukho kumazwi, ukwimisebenzi yakhe yemihla ngemihla.

sentence: Intaba engasemva kwendlu yethu inekhephu phezulu ngasekupheleni kukaJulayi.

sentence: Abelusi banyuka intaba kusasa kakhulu, belandela iigusha ezilahlekileyo.

sentence: Intaba leyo ibaluleke kakhulu kuthi, kuba amakhwenkwe ethu enziwa amadoda phaya.

sentence: Ingqolowa siyigaya ngokwethu ekhaya, ukuze umgubo ube mtsha xa sibhaka.

sentence: Ingqolowa yalo nyaka ayivunwanga kakuhle, kuba imvula ayizanga ngexesha.

sentence: Ndiyakholelwa ukuba ingqolowa yalapha ingcono kunaleyo ithengiswa ezivenkileni ezinkulu.

sentence: Umakhulu usixelela ngobusuku impi eyafika ngabo elalini, kwabaleka wonke umntu.

sentence: Impi kaHintsa yalwa namajoni aseBhritane kwiintaba zaseNciba, kwaphalala igazi.

sentence: Andikholelwa ukuba impi ingasombulula ingxaki phakathi kwabantu abalambileyo.

sentence: Utata wakhe wakha izindlu ezintathu elalini ngaphambi kokuba agule.

sentence: Kule lokishi izindlu zininzi kakhulu, kodwa amanzi afika kanye ngeveki.

sentence: Ndiyazikhumbula izindlu zakudala esasidlala kuzo, ngoku kukho iivenkile kuloo ndawo.

sentence: Ubani ohambe nezitshixo zam, ndime elangeni ngaphandle kwendlu?

sentence: Emva komngcwabo sasibuzana ukuba ubani oza kukhathalela abantwana ngoku.

sentence: Abaya bantu bemi esitophini sebhasi sele belinde iiyure ezimbini.

sentence: Abaya bathengisi abangaphesheya kwendlela bathengisa amaqanda ngexabiso eliphantsi kunelethu.

sentence: Andibathembi abaya bantu abahleli emotweni emnyama kufuphi nesango lethu.

sentence: Emva kweentsuku ezintathu elwandle, usindiso lwabo lwafika ngesikhephe sabalobi.

sentence: Umfundisi wathi usindiso alunakuthengwa ngemali, lufumaneka ngobabalo kuphela.

sentence: Kuye, usindiso lwafika ngohlobo lwencwadi eyayibhalwe ngumhlobo wakhe wakudala.

sentence: Ukholo lukamakhulu lwalusenza sithandaze phambi kwesidlo sangokuhlwa yonke imihla.

sentence: Ukholo lwakhe alumvumeli ukuba asebenze ngeCawa, ngoko utshintshiselana amaxesha neqabane lakhe.

sentence: Emva kokulahlekelwa ngumsebenzi, ukholo lwakhe lwaqina endaweni yokuncipha.

sentence: Umfo osithengisela iinkuni ufika ngeenyawo qho ngoMgqibelo kusasa.

sentence: Umfo wasekhaya wandifumanela umsebenzi kwifemu yakhe ngaphandle kokuba ndicele.

sentence: Umfo lowo undihlekisa kakhulu, kodwa akukho mntu owaziyo ukuba usebenza phi.

sentence: Iikomityi zonke zaphuka, kodwa isitya esikhulu sona sasala singonakalanga etafileni.

sentence: Isicwangciso sabo sona sasisihle, kodwa abazange bafumane imali yokuqalisa.

sentence: IsiXhosa sona ndisithetha kakuhle, kodwa andikwazi ukusibhala ngokuchanekileyo.

sentence: Utata ubuya emsebenzini emva kwentsimbi yesithandathu, size sitye sonke kunye.

sentence: Waya eGoli engenanto, wabuya elalini emva kweminyaka elishumi enemoto.

sentence: Andiqinisekanga ukuba uza kubuya, kodwa ndisamgcinele igumbi lakhe.

sentence: Utata wayesithi izono zabantwana zilula ukuxolelwa kunezo zabantu abadala.

sentence: Umfundisi wathi izono zethu zonke zixolelwa xa sizivuma ngokunyaniseka.

sentence: Izono zam zakudala zisandihlupha ebusuku, nangona sekudlule iminyaka emininzi.

sentence: Umntwana ukhala efuna unina oye kulanda amanzi emthonjeni ezantsi.

sentence: Utitshala ubize unina kaThandi esikolweni ukuze bathethe ngamanqaku akhe.

sentence: Wonke umntu uthi ufuze unina, kodwa yena akayithandi loo nto.

sentence: Amadoda ambatha iingubo ezimnyama xa kubanda emakhaya asemaphandleni.

sentence: Ekuseni amaxhego ambatha iingubo, ahlale elangeni ethetha ngemihla yakudala.

sentence: Amendu ale teksi ayasoyikisa, ndicela umqhubi ahambe kancinci.

sentence: Amathambo omntu omdala aphuka lula xa ewile endlwini yakhe.

sentence: Amacephe eplastikhi aphuka msinya, ngoko ndithenga awentsimbi kuphela ngoku.

sentence: Xa umlilo uqala ekhaya, baleka ngesango elingasemva ungakhethi mpahla.

sentence: Yiza apha sisi, bamba usana lwam okomzuzwana ndivule ucango.

sentence: Xa ibhola iza kuwe, bamba ngazo zombini izandla ungayilahli.

sentence: Iindwendwe ziza kufika emini; basa umlilo ngaphandle, sose inyama.

sentence: Kubanda kakhulu ngoku, basa amalahle embawuleni ukuze abantwana bafudumale.

sentence: Nomsa, beka izitya namacephe etafileni, ukutya sekulungile ngoku.

sentence: Xa ibhola isiza kuwe, betha ngamandla uyithumele kumdlali olandelayo.

sentence: Phambi kokuba uwele umgaqo, bheka ngapha nangapha kabini.

sentence: Thandi, biza abantwana bangene endlwini, imvula iyeza ngoku.

sentence: Ubuso bakhe baba bomvu xa wonke umntu emjonga, waphuma egumbini.

sentence: Bhuti, bonakala ekhaya ngeempelaveki, kudala umakhulu wakho engakuboni.

sentence: Bopha izihlangu zakho kakuhle, mntwana, singathanda ukufika ngexesha esikolweni.

sentence: Emva kokulayisha, bopha umthwalo ngentambo eqinileyo ukuze ungawi endleleni.
translation: After loading, fasten the load with strong rope so it doesn't fall off on the road.

sentence: Kwiholo lesikolo igosa libhalise abafundi abatsha bonke ngentsasa yanamhlanje.

sentence: Igqabi elityheli lehlile emthini, ngoku lidada emanzini echibi.

sentence: Umakhulu uthi igqirha lakuthi lisebenza nemichiza yezityalo zasentabeni.

sentence: Umzi wonke uhlonipha igqirha elihlala ngasemlanjeni, kuba linceda abantu abagulayo.

sentence: Ekhaya igusha yethu inamatakane amabini, siyawathanda kakhulu sonke.

sentence: Umalume wethu uthenge igusha enkulu kwimarike, uza kuyixhela ngoMgqibelo.

sentence: Igwebu lesepha ligcwele esinkini, khawuvule amanzi abandayo ulihlambe lonke.

sentence: Ulwandle lushiya igwebu elimhlophe elunxwemeni xa amaza ebetha amatye.

sentence: Sisebenzisa igwiba lomthi omkhulu ophambi kwendlu xa kunetha.

sentence: Ndifumene igwiba phantsi kwebhulorho ngethuba lesaqhwithi sangokuhlwa.

sentence: Namhlanje igxalaba lam libuhlungu emva kokuthwala le bhegi enzima.

sentence: Ugqirha uxilonge igxalaba lam wathi kufuneka ndiphumle iiveki ezimbini.

sentence: Utitshala uthe ihlelo ngalinye lezibizo linezivumelanisi zalo, ngoko masizifunde zonke.

sentence: Abazali bakhe abaseli utywala, kuba ihlelo labo lecawa alibuvumeli konke konke.

sentence: Ihlobo liyathandwa ngabantwana kuba bahlala bedada emlanjeni yonke imini.

sentence: Silinde ihlobo ukuze siye elwandle nosapho lwethu lonke.

sentence: Umntwana uphosa iinkozo phantsi, ihobe lizihlwitha ngokukhawuleza.

sentence: Iimbewu zemifuno zithengiswa kwivenkile yaselokishini ngexabiso eliphantsi.

sentence: Umakhulu ugcina iimbewu zamathanga engxoweni yephepha kude nemvula.

sentence: Umakhulu usivumela iingoma zakudala xa sihleli ngasemlilweni ebusuku.

sentence: Abafundi bafunda iingoma ezintathu zomnyhadala wesikolo ngaphambi kwekonsathi.

sentence: Utata ubeke iinyama ezintsha emlilweni, kwaye indlu yonke igcwele ivumba lazo.

sentence: Ikhephu lehlile ebusuku eMatatiele, iindlela ezininzi zivaliwe namhlanje kusasa.

sentence: Abantwana babona ikhephu okokuqala ngqa ebomini babo, bamangaliswa kakhulu.

sentence: Ikhonkco lebhayisikile yam liqhawukile, andikwazi ukuya edolophini namhlanje.

sentence: Ndifumene ikhonkco elincinci legolide phantsi kwesitulo, mhlawumbi lelakho.
translation: I found a small gold link under the chair — maybe it's yours.

sentence: Kukho ikroba elincinci eludongeni, umoya obandayo ungena ngalo ebusuku.
translation: There is a small gap in the wall; the cold air comes in through it at night.

sentence: Utata uvale ikroba lothango ngamaplanga ukuze iinkukhu zingaphumi.
translation: Father has closed the gap in the fence with planks so the chickens cannot get out.

sentence: Kwipeyinti endala kukho ilothe, into eyingozi kakhulu ebantwaneni abancinci.

sentence: Umthetho ukhusela ilungelo lakho lokuthetha ulwimi lwakho kwiinkundla zonke.

sentence: Abasebenzi bafuna ilungelo lokuphumla imizuzu engamashumi amathathu emini.

sentence: Imazi yethu izele ithole elibomvu, ngoko sinobisi olwaneleyo ekhaya.

sentence: Umalusi uqhuba imazi endala ngasemfuleni, amathole amabini alandela emva kwayo.
translation: The herder is driving the old cow along by the river, with two calves following behind her.

sentence: Ngasemthini omkhulu imbabala idla ingca, siyibukela singathethi.
translation: Next to the big tree a bushbuck is grazing; we watch it without saying a word.

sentence: Ekuseni sibone imbabala isela amanzi emlanjeni, yasuka yabaleka.
translation: In the morning we saw a bushbuck drinking water at the river; it took off and ran.

sentence: Ootata belali bahlangene ukuze baqwalasele imbambano ephakathi kwabamelwane ababini.
translation: The village elders met to look into the quarrel between the two neighbours.

sentence: Imbangi yale ngxabano ngumona, hayi imali njengoko besicinga ekuqaleni.
translation: The reason for this quarrel is jealousy, not money as we thought at first.

sentence: Ekhaya abantwana bafundiswa imbeko, babulise bonke abantu abadala.
translation: At home children are taught respect, and they greet all the elders.

sentence: Utitshala wethu ufumana imbeko enkulu kubafundi kuba ebaphulaphula ngokwenene.
translation: Our teacher gets a lot of respect from the students because he genuinely listens to them.

sentence: Imbiza enkulu isemlilweni, umngqusho uya kuvuthwa malunga neeyure ezimbini.
translation: The big pot is on the fire; the samp will be done in about two hours.

sentence: Umntwana ubethe intloko kule tafile kuba imbombo yayo ibukhali.

sentence: Imbuzi yakhe yaqhawula intambo yaza yatya imifuno yonke egadini kamakhulu.

sentence: Sithenge imbuzi emnyama emarikeni ukuze silungiselele umsitho wosapho ngeCawa.

sentence: Imfundo yabantwana ibalulekile, ngoko ke sigcina imali yesikolo bucala.

sentence: Umakhulu wam akazange afumane imfundo, kodwa wandifundisa izinto ezininzi.

sentence: Imifula emikhulu yaleli phondo igcwele amanzi ngeli xesha lemvula.
translation: The big rivers of this province are full of water in this rainy season.

sentence: Endleleni eya kowethu siwela imifula emibini ngebhulorho.
translation: On the road to our home we cross two rivers by bridge.

sentence: Kuthiwa imihlaba yasezilalini ivundile, kungoko abalimi bevuna umbona omninzi.
translation: They say the soils in the rural areas are fertile, which is why the farmers harvest plenty of maize.

sentence: Yathengiswa imihlaba emithathu yosapho lwakhe emva kokusweleka kukatatomkhulu.

sentence: Abantwana basule imilomo yabo ngeetawuli emva kokutya.

sentence: Oogqirha bathi masivale imilomo yethu xa sikhohlela phakathi kwabantu.
translation: Doctors say we should cover our mouths when we cough around people.

sentence: Iminwe yakhe imide kakhulu, uyakwazi ukudlala ipiyano ngokulula.
translation: His fingers are very long; he can play the piano easily.

sentence: Umakhulu uthunga impahla yonke imihla, kodwa iminwe iyaqaqamba ebusika.

sentence: Ugqirha uthi impambano yakhe yaqala emva kwengozi yemoto yonyaka ophelileyo.
translation: The doctor says her madness began after last year's car accident.

sentence: Uxinzelelo lomsebenzi lubangela impambano kubantu abasebenza ubusuku bonke.

sentence: Ndikunkcenkceshela yonke imihla, ngoko ke hluma ngokukhawuleza mbona wam.

sentence: Imvula yana izolo ebusuku, ngoku hluma uphume emhlabeni, mbewu yam.
translation: The rain fell last night; now sprout and come up out of the ground, my seed.

sentence: Ibala leti lisele ehempeni yam nangona ndiyihlambile kabini.

sentence: Umakhulu usibalisela ibali elimnandi ngokuhlwa phambi kokuba silale.
translation: Grandmother tells us a lovely story in the evening before we go to sleep.

sentence: Unyana wam ufunda ibanga lesithathu kwisikolo esikufuphi nekhaya lethu.

sentence: Ibanga leshumi linzima kakhulu, kodwa abafundi bethu balungiselela iimviwo ngoku.

sentence: Usana lumunya ibele likanina ngaphambi kokuba lulale ubusuku bonke.
translation: The baby suckles at its mother's breast before sleeping through the night.

sentence: Ugqirha uxelele umama ukuba ahlole ibele ngalinye inyanga nenyanga ekhaya.

sentence: Emva kwendlu kukho ibhokhwe emhlophe etya ingca yonke imini.
translation: Behind the house there is a white goat eating grass all day.

sentence: Umalume uthengise ibhokhwe yakhe ukuze afumane imali yezifundo zomntwana.

sentence: Ibhotwe lenkosi limi phezu kwenduli, libonwa nangabahambi abadlula ngendlela.

sentence: Abakhenkethi batyelele ibhotwe likakumkani ngempelaveki, bathatha imifanekiso emininzi.

sentence: Ibhunga lesixeko lithembise ukulungisa iindlela ezonakeleyo phambi kwehlobo.

sentence: Kwintlanganiso yangoLwesine, ibhunga lesikolo lavuma ukuthenga iincwadi ezintsha zabafundi.

sentence: Ibunzi lakhe ligcwele umbilo emva kokubaleka ibanga elide.
translation: His forehead is covered in sweat after running a long distance.

sentence: Umntwana wawa wazibetha ibunzi etafileni, wakhala ixesha elide.
translation: The child fell and hit his forehead on the table, and cried for a long time.

sentence: Kule venkile icandelo leziqhamo likwicala lasekhohlo, kufuphi neminyango.
translation: In this shop the fruit section is on the left-hand side, near the doors.

sentence: Utitshala usinike icandelo elinye lencwadi ukuba silifunde ngaphambi kovavanyo.
translation: The teacher gave us one section of the book to read before the test.

sentence: Icesina yomntwana ayikapheli nangoku, ngoko siya kumsa eklinikhi kusasa.

sentence: Emva kweentsuku ezintathu icesina yaphela, waza umfana wabuyela esikolweni.
translation: After three days the fever broke, and the young man went back to school.

sentence: Ehlotyeni ichibi elingasekhaya lomile, iinkomo zisela emlanjeni ngoku.
translation: In summer the pond near home dries up, so the cattle drink at the river now.

sentence: Kubafundi abasandula ukuphumelela, idabi lokufumana umsebenzi linzima kakhulu edolophini.
translation: For young graduates, the battle to find work is very hard in town.

sentence: Amajoni abuyile ekhaya edinwe kakhulu emva kokuba idabi liphelile.
translation: The soldiers came home exhausted after the battle was over.

sentence: Idiliya elinye lawa esityeni laza lagingqika laya phantsi kwetafile.
translation: One grape fell out of the dish and rolled under the table.

sentence: Umakhulu unika umntwana ngamnye idiliya emva kwesidlo sangokuhlwa ngaphambi kokulala.
translation: Grandmother gives each child a grape after supper, before bedtime.

sentence: Idlelo elingasemlanjeni linengca eluhlaza nangexesha lasebusika kule minyaka.
translation: The pasture by the river has green grass even in winter these years.

sentence: Ilanga elitshisayo lomise idlelo, ngoko abafuyi bathenga ingca yokutyisa iinkomo.

sentence: Emva komsebenzi, dlula kowethu, ndikuphathele isipho somntwana wakho.

sentence: Ukuba ubona umgca omde evenkileni, dlula uze ubuye emva kwemini.
translation: If you see a long queue at the shop, walk on past and come back in the afternoon.

sentence: Amanzi emilanjeni yale ngingqi amdaka kakhulu ngenxa yenkunkuma elahlwa ngabantu.

sentence: Ngaphambi kokuthenga iselfowuni entsha, fanisa amaxabiso ezivenkileni ezimbini.

sentence: Ungakhawulezi ukugweba; fanisa iingxelo zamacala omabini kuqala.

sentence: Fumana isitifiketi sakho sokuzalwa kuqala, ungenzi sicelo ngaphandle kwaso.

sentence: Ukuba ufuna umsebenzi, fumana uluhlu lweenkampani eziqeshayo kule veki.

sentence: Yiba nesibindi, funa ilungelo lakho, ungoyiki ukubuza imibuzo enzima.

sentence: Phambi kwenkundla, funga ukuba uthetha inyaniso, ungabuyi uguqule amazwi akho.

sentence: Ndiyakuthemba, kodwa funga kum ukuba awuyi kuxelela mntu le mfihlelo.

sentence: Mntanam, gcina imali yakho ebhankini, kunokuba uyifihle endlwini.

sentence: Thatha esi sitya, gcina intsalela yesidlo efrijini ukuze ingonakali.

sentence: Emva kobu bunzima bonke, gcoba kuba iindaba zilungile ngoku.

sentence: Le mpahla intle kakhulu, kodwa ixabiso layo liphezulu gqitha.

sentence: Thandi, gqobhoza umngxuma omncinci kwisiciko ukuze umphunga uphume.

sentence: Ukuze ufake intambo, gqobhoza esi sikhumba ngenaliti enkulu.

sentence: Guqa phantsi ukuze ukhangele phantsi kwebhedi, ithoyi lomntwana liwele apho.

sentence: Xa uhlamba lo mgangatho, guqa ngamadolo, ungazami ukusebenza umile.

sentence: Guquka ujonge kum ukuze ndithathe umfanekiso wakho omhle.

sentence: Mlawuli womdlalo, gweba ngobulungisa ukuze omabini amaqela aneliseke.

sentence: Hlaba ithumba ngenaliti ecocekileyo, emva koko ulibophe ngelaphu elimhlophe.

sentence: Hlaba le bhokhwe ngoku, bhuti, izihlobo sezifikile emsebenzini wasekhaya.

sentence: Ukutya sekulungile; hlamba izandla zakho ngesepha ngaphambi kokuba uphakelwe.

sentence: Emva kokudlala ebaleni, hlamba umzimba wakho uze utshintshe iimpahla.

sentence: Wena geza wedwa apho, thina siyagoduka ngoku kuba sidiniwe.

sentence: Ndithenge iqhiya nesikipa emarikeni ngoMgqibelo, zange ndisebenzise imali eninzi.

sentence: Ukuba ufuna, khubeka ngamazwi am, kodwa bendithetha inyaniso kuphela.

sentence: Sebenza kanzima esikolweni, lingana nabanye abafundi abazimiseleyo.

sentence: Ukuba ufuna impilo entle, naka amazwi kagqirha ngokutya kwakho.

sentence: Mlambo wethu, phalala kwakhona ukuze iinkomo zethu zisele.

sentence: Sifo ndini, tshabalala, umama wam ufuna ukuphila kakuhle nathi.

sentence: Ngale mpelaveki umnyanya wookhokho bethu uza kubanjelwa ekhaya.

sentence: Izolo uthambo lwengalo yakhe lwaphukile xa ewa ebhayisekileni.

sentence: Mlilo wasekhaya, vutha ubusuku bonke, ugcine igumbi lifudumele.

sentence: Kwintlanganiso yamanina, abafazi bakhalaza besithi abayeni babo abancedi ekhaya.

sentence: Amazwe amabini ahluka kakhulu ngokutya, ngomculo nangolwimi lwawo.

sentence: Amaxabiso ahluka kwivenkile nganye, ngoko ndijikeleza ndithelekisa ngaphambi kokuthenga.

sentence: Bafundi, amacebo enu okuphucula isikolo mawathunyelwe kusihlalo phambi koLwesihlanu.

sentence: Abafana babeke amacebo amathathu okuqhuba umnyhadala welali kunyaka ozayo.

sentence: Amafutha okupheka aphelile, ndiza kuthenga amanye evenkileni.

sentence: Ugqirha uthe amafutha amaninzi ekutyeni ayingozi kwintliziyo yam.

sentence: Amakhosazana alapha elalini avuka kusasa aye kukha amanzi emlanjeni.

sentence: Kumtshato kaThandi, amakhosazana amabini ahamba phambili ephethe iintyatyambo.

sentence: NgeMigqibelo amakhwenkwe adlala ibhola ebaleni kude kutshone ilanga.

sentence: Umama uthumele amakhwenkwe amabini evenkileni ukuba athenge isonka neswekile.

sentence: Ndithenge amaqanda alishumi evenkileni, ndiza kupheka isidlo sakusasa ngomso.

sentence: Iinkukhu zikatatomkhulu zizalele amaqanda amaninzi kule mpelaveki idlulileyo.

sentence: Xa ndiva ivumba lenyama eyosiweyo, amathe am ayehla ngoko nangoko.

sentence: Musa ukutshica amathe phantsi, sebenzisa itishu uze uyilahle emgqomeni.

sentence: Le mela iya kuba bukhali xa uyilola kakuhle ngelitye lokulola.

sentence: Amazwi akhe aye abe bukhali xa enomsindo, kodwa uyaxolisa emva koko.

sentence: Bulala ezo mbovane ezisegumbini lokutyela ngaphambi kokuba zande.

sentence: Ndiyakucela, bulala ezi mpukane ezingcolisa ukutya kwethu etafileni.

sentence: Bulisa abazali bakhe kuqala, emva koko uchaze isizathu sokufika kwakho.

sentence: Xa ungena eklasini, bulisa utitshala uze uhlale phantsi ngokuzolileyo.

sentence: Izembe liya kuba buthuntu xa usoloko usika amatye ngalo.

sentence: Imela yaba buthuntu emva kokusika amathambo enkomo ubusuku bonke.

sentence: Sana lwam, buyela esikolweni ngoMvulo, utitshala wakho uyakulinda.

sentence: Ukuba iyeza alincedi, buyela kugqirha uze umxelele ngeempawu ezintsha.

sentence: Khawuleza bhuti, buyisa imali yam phambi kokuba impelaveki ifike.

sentence: Umfundi ophumeleleyo wema nkqo phambi kwabantu bonke waza wathetha.

sentence: Le nkwenkwe idlala ibhola ngempelaveki kunye nabahlobo bayo.

sentence: Utitshala ubuzile ukuba loo nkwenkwe ingene kweliphi ibanga kulo nyaka.
translation: The teacher asked which grade that boy has gone into this year.

sentence: Wena nqwenela into oyifunayo, kodwa usebenze kanzima ukuze uyifumane.

sentence: Xa ubona inkwenkwezi ebusuku, nqwenela into entle uze ulale.
translation: When you see a star at night, wish for something good and then go to sleep.

sentence: Nuka le ntyatyambo, ivumba layo limnandi ngaphezu kwesiqholo sikamama.

sentence: Ukuba akundikholelwa, nuka le nyama phambi kokuba uyipheke ngokuhlwanje.

sentence: Nxiba idyasi yakho, kubanda kakhulu ngaphandle namhlanje.

sentence: Xa usiya emngcwabeni, nxiba impahla emnyama nezihlangu ezicocekileyo.
translation: When you go to a funeral, wear black clothes and clean shoes.

sentence: Wena nxila namhlanje, ngomso uya kuba nentloko ebuhlungu kakhulu.
translation: You go ahead and drink yourself drunk today; tomorrow you will have a terrible headache.

sentence: Nyamezela mntwana wam, le ntlungu iza kudlula kungekudala.
translation: Be patient, my child; this pain will pass before long.

sentence: Yima ngxi, nyamezela ixesha elifutshane, ugqirha uza kufika kwakamsinya.
translation: Hold steady, endure a little longer — the doctor will be here shortly.

sentence: Ndiyakucela gqirha, nyanga umntwana wam kuqala, uyagula kakhulu.
translation: I'm asking you, doctor, treat my child first, he is very ill.

sentence: Qala ngokucoca inxeba, emva koko nyanga isilonda ngala mafutha.
translation: First clean the wound, then treat the sore with this ointment.

sentence: Nyathela apha kweli litye elikhulu ukuze ungangeni eludakeni olumanzi.

sentence: Nyathela kuqala kule ngxowa yenkunkuma ukuze ingene yonke into emgqomeni.

sentence: Nyula iiapile ezintle kule bhokisi, uzishiye ezibolileyo ukuze sizilahle.

sentence: Xa usiya emsebenzini, nyula ihempe ehambelana nebhulukhwe yakho emnyama.

sentence: Nyusa kancinci isandi sikanomathotholo, umakhulu akasiva isibhengezo semozulu.

sentence: Ukuba iindleko ziyenyuka, nyusa amaxabiso empahla yakho kancinci.

sentence: Ndisakhumbula ubusuku obuya, kwakubanda kakhulu kwaye kwakungekho mbane ekhaya.

sentence: Utata uza kululungisa oluya cango lwasekhitshini kuba aluvaleki kakuhle.

sentence: Ndikhethe olu luhlu, kodwa umphathi ufuna oluya lwokuqala.
translation: I chose this list, but the manager wants that first one over there.

sentence: Khupha inkunkuma ngaphandle ngoku, inqwelo yenkunkuma ifika ngentseni ngoLwesithathu.

sentence: Mama, lala phantsi kwalo mthunzi uphumle, ndiza kukubiza xa sigqibile.

sentence: Musa ukutya phakathi kwezidlo imini yonke, lamba, uze utye kamnandi ngokuhlwa.

sentence: Ukuba ufuna ukuphumelela, landela imiyalelo katitshala wakho ngokupheleleyo.
translation: If you want to pass, follow your teacher's instructions completely.

sentence: Bhuti, landela le ndlela ide iphele, uze ujike ngasekhohlo esikolweni.
translation: Brother, follow this road to its end, then turn left at the school.

sentence: Ukuba ufuna ukuhlonitshwa ngabantu, lawula ngentembeko, ungasebenzisi uloyiko.
translation: If you want people to respect you, govern with integrity — don't use fear.

sentence: Bhuti, lawula imali yakho kakuhle ukuze ungabi netyala ekupheleni kwenyanga.
translation: Brother, manage your money well so you're not in debt at the end of the month.

sentence: Ndiyakucela, libala ngaloo ngxabano yezolo, masiqale phantsi namhlanje.

sentence: Phumla kancinci, libala ngomsebenzi okwangoku, uze ubuyele kuwo ngomso.
translation: Rest a little, forget about the work for now, and come back to it tomorrow.

sentence: Ukuba kufuneka, lila; andisayi kukugweba ngeenyembezi zakho.
translation: If you need to, cry; I am not going to judge you for your tears.

sentence: Thetha nam okanye lila, mna ndiza kuhlala apha nawe.
translation: Talk to me or cry, I am going to sit here with you.

sentence: Tata, lima le ntsimi kwangoku, iimvula ziza kufika kwiveki ezayo.

sentence: Sisi, lindela ithuba lakho ngomonde, wonke umntu uza kufumana elakhe.
translation: Sister, wait for your turn patiently — everyone will get their own.

sentence: Musa ukuhamba, lindela umama wakho phambi kwevenkile ade afike.
translation: Don't go off — wait for your mother in front of the shop until she arrives.

sentence: Londoloza amanzi ehlotyeni, uze uvale impompo xa ugqibile.
translation: Conserve water in summer, and close the tap when you are done.

sentence: Hamba kancinci, londoloza amandla akho, kuba indlela inde kakhulu.
translation: Walk slowly, save your strength, because the road is very long.

sentence: Umbala wale ngubo luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, uhambelana kakuhle nezihlangu zakho.
translation: The colour of this blanket is sky blue; it goes well with your shoes.

sentence: Umthwalo waba lula emva kokuba sithathe amanye amatye kuwo.
translation: The load became light after we took some of the stones out of it.

sentence: Hamba kancinci, lumka, umgaqo umanzi kwaye iimoto ziyabaleka.
translation: Walk slowly, be careful, the road is wet and the cars are speeding.

sentence: Xa uhamba wedwa ebusuku edolophini, lumka ungaphathi imali eninzi.
translation: When you walk alone at night in town, be careful and don't carry a lot of money.

sentence: Tata, lungisa isitulo esophukileyo phambi kokuba umntu ahlale kuso.
translation: Dad, fix the broken chair before someone sits on it.

sentence: Ndikuboleka izixhobo zam, lungisa umbhobho ovuzayo egumbini lokuhlambela.
translation: I'm lending you my tools — fix the leaking pipe in the bathroom.

sentence: Ngomso ekuseni, lusa iigusha zethu emadlelweni angasemlanjeni, ungakhawulezi.
translation: Tomorrow morning, herd our sheep in the pastures by the river, and don't rush.

sentence: Mntanam, qina, izifundo zakho ziza kuba lula ngokuhamba kwexesha.
translation: My child, be strong; your studies will get easier as time goes on.

sentence: Xa ubaleka umgama omde, qina emva kwekhilomitha yesihlanu, apho kunzima khona.
translation: When you run a long distance, hold firm after the fifth kilometre, where it gets hard.

sentence: Qinisa la mabhanti ngaphambi kokuba sihambe, umthwalo usenokuwa endleleni.
translation: Tighten these straps before we leave — the load could still fall off on the road.

sentence: Tata, qonda ukuba umntwana usafunda, ungamngxolisi ngenxa yempazamo encinane.
translation: Dad, understand that the child is still learning; don't scold him over a small mistake.

sentence: Funda lo mhlathi kabini, qonda umxholo wawo, uze ubhale isishwankathelo.
translation: Read this paragraph twice, grasp its main point, and then write a summary.

sentence: Xa singena endlwini yokuthandaza, qubuda ngokuzolileyo ungathethi nabanye abantu.
translation: When we go into the prayer room, bow down quietly and don't talk to the other people.

sentence: Ngaphambi kokutya, qubuda uthandaze kuqala, njengoko umakhulu wakho ekufundisile.
translation: Before eating, bow your head and pray first, the way your grandmother taught you.

sentence: Sondela apha, rhola le ngxowa yombona siyifake enqwelweni.
translation: Come closer, drag this sack of maize so we can load it onto the cart.

sentence: Xa uphangela edolophini, rhweba ngokunyaniseka nabo bonke abathengi bakho.
translation: When you work in town, trade honestly with all your customers.

sentence: Namhlanje sebenza ngokukhuthala, ngomso siza kuphumla sonke ekhaya.
translation: Work hard today; tomorrow we will all rest at home.

sentence: Utata wathi kum: 'Mfana, sebenza uze ufunde, akukho nto elula ebomini.'
translation: Father said to me: 'Son, work and study; there is nothing easy in life.'

sentence: Mama, seza umntwana eli yeza kabini ngemini kude liphele.
translation: Mom, give the child this medicine twice a day until it's finished.

sentence: Ndicela undincede, seza lo mntwana ngeli yeza xa ndingekho.
translation: Please help me out — give this child the medicine when I'm not around.

sentence: Shenxisa izitulo ziye ecaleni, abantwana bafuna indawo yokudlala egumbini.
translation: Move the chairs over to the side, the children want space to play in the room.

sentence: Tata, shenxisa imoto kancinci ukuze ndikwazi ukuphuma egaraji ngokukhawuleza.
translation: Dad, move the car a bit so that I can get out of the garage quickly.

sentence: Sukuhlala apho emnyango, shukuma kancinci ukuze ndikwazi ukudlula.
translation: Don't just stand there in the doorway; move a little so that I can get past.

sentence: Ukuba uyawuva umculo, shukuma nawe, ungoyiki ukudanisa phambi kwabantu.
translation: If you feel the music, move too; don't be afraid to dance in front of people.

sentence: Amanzi aya kuba shushu emva kwemizuzu emihlanu, ungawabambi ngesandla.
translation: The water will be hot in five minutes; don't grab it with your hand.

sentence: Fudumeza isuphu ide ibe shushu, uze uyifake ezityeni zabantwana.
translation: Heat the soup until it's hot, then serve it into the children's bowls.

sentence: Thatha imela ebukhali, sika ikhekhe libe ngamacandelo alishumi.
translation: Take a sharp knife and cut the cake into ten pieces.

sentence: Sebenzisa isikere, sika eli phepha ulandele umgca omnyama obhalwe apha.
translation: Use scissors, cut this paper following the black line drawn here.

sentence: Makhulu, sikelela umzukulwana wakho ophuma esiya kufunda eKapa.

sentence: Phambi kokuba sitye, tata, sikelela ukutya ngamazwi ambalwa.
translation: Before we eat, Dad, say a blessing over the food in a few words.

sentence: Nceda, sindisa ikati ehleli phezu komthi, iyoyika ukuhla.
translation: Please rescue the cat sitting up in the tree, it is afraid to come down.

sentence: Ukuba uyakwazi ukuqubha, sindisa umntwana owileyo edamini.
translation: If you can swim, rescue the child who has fallen into the dam.

sentence: Xa ufika kwirobhothi, singa ngasekunene, ikhaya lethu likufuphi nesikolo.
translation: When you get to the traffic light, head right; our home is near the school.

sentence: Musa ukuma apha, singa endlwini ngoku, imvula iyana.
translation: Don't stand here, head into the house now, it's raining.

sentence: Sukela ibhola, Sipho, ungamvumeli loo mdlali adlule ngasecaleni kwakho.
translation: Chase the ball, Sipho, don't let that player get past you on the outside.

sentence: Sukela ezo nkukhu ziphume egadini, zitya imifuno yonke kamama.
translation: Chase those chickens out of the garden, they are eating all of Mum's vegetables.

sentence: Ngoku susa ezi zitya etafileni ngaphambi kokuba kufike iindwendwe zethu.
translation: Now take these dishes off the table before our visitors arrive.

sentence: Ngaphambi kokupeyinta, susa lonke ithuli eludongeni ngelaphu elimanzi.
translation: Before painting, remove all the dust from the wall with a damp cloth.

sentence: Mntwana wam, thanda abantwana odlala nabo esikolweni.
translation: My child, love the children you play with at school.

sentence: Thandaza nathi ngaphambi kokuba sitye, umakhulu uthanda ukuva ilizwi lakho.
translation: Pray with us before we eat — Grandma likes to hear your voice.

sentence: Xa uxhalabile ngeziphumo zeemviwo, thandaza uze ulale, kusasa kuya kulunga.
translation: When you're anxious about the exam results, say a prayer and then sleep — it will be better in the morning.

sentence: Thenga isonka, ubisi neqanda xa usiya evenkileni namhlanje.
translation: Buy bread, milk and an egg when you go to the shop today.

sentence: Thengisa la maqanda kubamelwane bethu ngaphambi kokuba onakale, kuba kushushu kakhulu.
translation: Sell these eggs to our neighbours before they go off — it's very hot.

sentence: Ukuba awunamali kule nyanga, thengisa iinkukhu ezimbini zakho emarikeni.
translation: If you're short of money this month, sell two of your chickens at the market.

sentence: Mnumzana, thimba iifowuni zabafundi abaphazamisa iklasi ngexesha lovavanyo.
translation: Sir, confiscate the phones of the pupils who are disrupting the class during the test.

sentence: Musa ukumbetha umntwana; thimba umdlalo wakhe iiveki ezimbini ukuze afunde.
translation: Don't hit the child; take his game away for two weeks so that he learns.

sentence: Xa ungaqinisekanga, thingaza kancinci uze ubuze imibuzo phambi kokusayina isivumelwano.
translation: When you're not sure, hesitate a little and ask questions before signing the agreement.

sentence: Ukuba ufuna abathengi abaninzi, thoba amaxabiso ezihlangu zakho.
translation: If you want more customers, lower the prices of your shoes.

sentence: Xa ufika ekhaya, thuma umntwana kum ukuze ndazi ukuba uphilile.
translation: When you get home, send me a message so I know you are well.

sentence: Ungandilindi, thuma abantwana esitolo bathenge isonka nobisi.
translation: Don't wait for me — send the children to the shop to buy bread and milk.

sentence: Nomsa, thumela umyalezo kutata xa ufika esikolweni, ukuze angakhathazeki.
translation: Nomsa, send Dad a message when you get to school so that he doesn't worry.

sentence: Bhala igama lakho kuqala, thumela ifom kwiofisi phambi kokuba liphele ixesha.
translation: Write your name first, then send the form to the office before the time runs out.

sentence: Ndiyacela, thwala le bhegi yezitya, mna ndiphethe amanzi nesonka.

sentence: Nomsa, tshiseka ngezifundo zakho ngoku, kuba uvavanyo lusondele.
translation: Nomsa, be keen about your studies now, because the exam is close.

sentence: Ukuba ufuna ukuphumelela, tshiseka ekufundeni, ungalindi ukuqhutywa ngutitshala.

sentence: Twabulula ingubo emthunzini womthi ukuze sihlale phantsi sitye isidlo sasemini.

sentence: Emva kwemvula yokuqala, tyala imbewu yombona kwintsimi yakho.
translation: After the first rain, plant the maize seed in your field.

sentence: Ukuba unethuba ngempelaveki, tyala umthi wamaqunube emva kwendlu.
translation: If you have time on the weekend, plant a berry tree behind the house.

sentence: Emva kokusinda engozini, utata wabulela uSomandla ngentsapho yakhe.

sentence: Umakhulu uthandaza rhoqo kusasa, ecela uThixo asikhusele sonke.

sentence: Kwintlanganiso yakusasa, umfundisi uthi uYesu wafundisa abantu ngothando.

sentence: Umama wam uthemba uYesu kuzo zonke iingxaki zakhe.
translation: My mother trusts Jesus through all her troubles.

sentence: Ndisadlala ibhola, ubambo lwam lwaphuka, ngoko ndaphumla iiveki ezintandathu ekhaya.

sentence: Ekhaya sithanda ubambo lwegusha xa lojiwe kakuhle emlilweni wamalahle.

sentence: Ubizo lwakhe kukufundisa abantwana abangaboniyo, uyawuthanda umsebenzi wakhe.

sentence: Uyise wamkhuthaza ukuba alandele ubizo lwakhe lokuba ngumculi.

sentence: Ubudoda bomntu bubonakala kwindlela athwala ngayo uxanduva lwentsapho yakhe.

sentence: Utatomkhulu wayesithi ubudoda buqala ngokuhlonipha umama wakho nabantwana bakho.

sentence: Elalini yethu ubugqwirha buyoyikwa kakhulu, ngoko abantu abahambi bodwa ebusuku.

sentence: Utitshala wethu wasixelela ukuba ubugqwirha abukho, sifanele sifune izizathu zesayensi.

sentence: Ubuhlobo bethu noThandi buqale esikolweni samabanga aphantsi, busekho nanamhlanje.

sentence: Ndixabisa ubuhlobo bakho, kodwa andivumelani nesigqibo osithathileyo izolo.

sentence: Ubuhlwempu bubangela ukuba abantwana abaninzi bayeke isikolo bengekagqibi ibanga leshumi.

sentence: Urhulumente uthembise ukuphelisa ubuhlwempu ngokudala amathuba engqesho emaphandleni.

sentence: Kwintlanganiso yesikolo, ubukho babazali bubalulekile kakhulu kubantwana babo.

sentence: Ubukhwele bakhe bubonakala xa ndincokola nabanye abahlobo bam.
translation: His jealousy shows whenever I chat with my other friends.

sentence: Kwikhaya lethu ubukhwele babantwana buqala xa omnye efumana isipho esikhulu.

sentence: Ndiyabuthanda ubulali bakhe xa ethetha nabantu abadala.

sentence: Ndafunda kutatomkhulu ukuba ubulali abubobugwala, bungamandla endoda.

sentence: Umphathi usichazele ubume bomsebenzi ngaphambi kokuba siqalise ukusebenza kwifektri.
translation: The manager explained the shape of the job to us before we started work at the factory.

sentence: Yonke into ilungile kule keyiki, ubumnandi bayo bubonisa ukuba umama uyayazi into ayenzayo.

sentence: Abantu abadala bathi ubungcwele bebandla buqala ngendlela esiphatha ngayo abanye.

sentence: Ubungcwele abunakufundwa encwadini kuphela; bubonakala kwizenzo zomntu zemihla ngemihla.

sentence: Ekuseni ndifaka ubusi kwiti yam endaweni yeswekile.
translation: In the morning I put honey in my tea instead of sugar.

sentence: Umalume uthengisa ubusi beenyosi zakhe kubamelwane bethu ngeCawa.
translation: My uncle sells honey from his bees to our neighbours on Sundays.

sentence: Ndiyabuthiya ubusika balo nyaka, kubanda kakhulu ngaphandle.
translation: I hate this year's winter; it is very cold outside.

sentence: Emva kwemvula udaka lugcwele endleleni, ngoko sihamba kancinci ngemoto.
translation: After the rain there is mud all over the road, so we drive slowly.

sentence: Umakhulu usebenzisa udaka nengca ukwakha iindonga zendlu yakhe.

sentence: Utata uthenge udidi olutsha lwembewu evelisa umbona omkhulu.
translation: Dad bought a new kind of seed that produces big maize.

sentence: Sifuna udidi lwezinja ezingakhonkothi kakhulu kuba sihlala kwiflethi.
translation: We want a breed of dog that doesn't bark much, because we live in a flat.

sentence: Umenzi weembiza uxuba udongwe namanzi de luthambe kakuhle.
translation: The potter mixes clay and water until it softens properly.

sentence: Ngoku udumo lwakhe lwandile emva kokuba ingoma yakhe idlalwe kunomathotholo.
translation: His fame has grown now that his song has been played on the radio.

sentence: Utata uthi udumo lwabadlali bebhola aluhlali ixesha elide.
translation: Dad says footballers' fame doesn't last long.

sentence: Utatomkhulu uxhome ufele lwegusha eludongeni lwegumbi lakhe lokulala.
translation: Grandfather hung a sheepskin on the wall of his bedroom.

sentence: Uhlobo lwesonka olwenziwa ngumakhulu lumnandi kunolo lwasevenkile.
translation: The kind of bread grandmother makes is tastier than the shop's.

sentence: Kwivenkile enkulu kukho uhlobo lweti olunevumba lelamuni.
translation: In the big shop there is a kind of tea that smells of lemon.

sentence: Amagqabi omthi oma msinyane xa kungekho mvula ehlotyeni.

sentence: Khawuleza, phakama, ibhasi yesikolo ifika ngemizuzu elishumi.

sentence: Ukuba uvumelana nathi, phakama ubonise inkxaso yakho.

sentence: Phakamisa isandla sakho xa ufuna ukubuza umbuzo eklasini.
translation: Raise your hand when you want to ask a question in class.

sentence: Phakamisa ilitye elo ubone ukuba kukho ntoni ngaphantsi kwalo.
translation: Lift that stone and see what's underneath it.

sentence: Sela amanzi anetyuwa, emva koko phalaza ukuze ususe ubuhlungu besisu.
translation: Drink salted water, then bring it up to get rid of the stomach pain.

sentence: Phambuka ngasekunene emva kwebhulorho, uze uqhubeke ude ufike epompini yepetroli.

sentence: Phatha le bhegi kakuhle, kukho iiglasi ngaphakathi ezinokwaphuka lula.
translation: Carry this bag carefully — there are glasses inside that break easily.

sentence: Xa usiya emsebenzini ngomso, phatha isambrela, kuthiwa liza kuna.

sentence: Phendula umnxeba, mhlawumbi ngumama ofuna ukusixelela ukuba ufikile esikolweni.

sentence: Phezolo bekubanda kakhulu, ndaza ndavala amafestile onke egumbini lam.
translation: Last night it was very cold, so I closed all the windows in my room.

sentence: Imvula yana kakhulu phezolo, ngoku indlela eya esikolweni inodaka.
translation: It rained hard last night, and now the road to school is muddy.

sentence: Mhlobo wam, phila kakuhle kwelo lizwe, uze usibhalele.
translation: My friend, keep well in that country, and write to us.

sentence: Emva kokuphuma esibhedlele, phila ngokuthula ekhaya ude uqine.
translation: After leaving hospital, live quietly at home until you are strong again.

sentence: Ndixolele, phinda loo mbuzo, bendingakuva kakuhle ngenxa yengxolo.
