sentence: Ungadinwa, phinda uvavanyo ngonyaka ozayo, ndiyaqiniseka ukuba uya kuphumelela.
translation: Don't give up — sit the exam again next year; I am sure you will pass.

sentence: Sikuthembile sonke ekhaya; phumelela kwezi mviwo zokugqibela, mntwana wam.
translation: We all believe in you at home; pass these final exams, my child.

sentence: Ungalahli ithemba; phumelela kulo mdlalo, uze ubuye nendebe.
translation: Don't give up hope; win this match and come back with the trophy.

sentence: Phumla ngoku, umsebenzi wegadi uya kulinda de kubande ngokuhlwa.
translation: Rest now — the garden work can wait until it cools down in the evening.

sentence: Ukuba usaziva udiniwe emva kweentsuku ezimbini, phumla, ungayi emsebenzini ngomso.
translation: If you still feel tired after two days, rest — don't go to work tomorrow.

sentence: Lala ngoku, mntwana wam, phupha ngezinto ezimnandi zosuku lwakho lokuzalwa.
translation: Sleep now, my child, and dream about the good things of your birthday.

sentence: Phupha ngendlu enkulu, kodwa uvuke kusasa uye emsebenzini yonke imihla.
translation: Dream of a big house, but get up early and go to work every day.

sentence: Ngoko ke, phuthuma abantwana esikolweni ngaphambi kokuba imvula ine ngamandla.
translation: So then, fetch the children from school before the rain comes down hard.

sentence: Bhuti, phuthuma ihashe elibalekileyo phambi kokuba lingene emasimini abamelwane.
translation: Brother, go fetch the horse that ran off before it gets into the neighbours' fields.

sentence: Xa ufika esikolweni, qala ngokubulisa ootitshala bakho bonke.
translation: When you get to school, start by greeting all your teachers.

sentence: Yiza apha, qala ukupheka ngelixa ndiyokuthenga umgubo evenkileni.
translation: Come here, start cooking while I go and buy flour at the shop.

sentence: Ngoku qhama, mthi wam, sele ndikunkcenkceshele iminyaka emithathu ndilinde iziqhamo.
translation: Now bear fruit, my tree — I've been watering you for three years, waiting for fruit.

sentence: Ukuba unelayisensi, qhuba imoto kamalume ude ufike edolophini.
translation: If you have a licence, drive uncle's car until you reach town.

sentence: Ukhozi lubhabha phezulu phezu kweentaba, lukhangela umvundla emathafeni.
translation: The eagle flies high above the mountains, looking for a hare on the plains.

sentence: Ukhozo lombona luwile phantsi kwetafile, inkukhu ilucholile ngokukhawuleza.
translation: A kernel of maize fell under the table and the hen quickly picked it up.

sentence: Inyoni yathatha ukhozo lwengqolowa yabhabha yaya emthini omkhulu.
translation: The bird took a grain of wheat and flew off to the big tree.

sentence: Kusapho lwethu ukoluka kubalulekile kakhulu, kuqhutywa ngendlela efanelekileyo.
translation: In our family initiation matters a great deal, and it is carried out in the proper way.

sentence: Abadala basifundisa ukuba ukoluka kudibanisa imbeko, isibindi noxanduva lobudoda.
translation: The elders teach us that initiation brings together respect, courage and the responsibility of manhood.

sentence: Umthetho uthi ukubulala izilwanyana zasendle akuvumelekanga kwiipaki zesizwe.
translation: The law says killing wild animals is not permitted in the national parks.

sentence: Ekhaya sifundiswa ukuba ukubulala izinambuzane ezingenabungozi akufanelekanga.
translation: At home we are taught that killing harmless insects is not right.

sentence: Ukuhleka kwakhe okukhulu kwasenza sonke sahleka egumbini lokutyela.
translation: His loud laughter made all of us laugh in the dining room.

sentence: Ndiyakuthanda ukuhleka, kuyandinceda xa usuku lunzima emsebenzini.
translation: I love laughing; it helps me when the day is hard at work.

sentence: Ukukhetha umntu ofanelekileyo kulo msebenzi kuthatha ixesha elide.
translation: Choosing the right person for this job takes a long time.

sentence: Ndiyathanda ukukhetha iimpahla zam ngokwam xa ndisiya edolophini.
translation: I like choosing my own clothes when I go to town.

sentence: Kule mihla ukulima kufuna umonde nemvula eyaneleyo, kodwa isivuno siyavuyisa.
translation: These days farming takes patience and enough rain, but the harvest is a joy.

sentence: Utatomkhulu uthanda ukulima, usityalela imifuno emitsha kwigadi yakhe.
translation: Grandfather loves farming; he grows fresh vegetables for us in his garden.

sentence: Konke ukutya kwasekhaya kumnandi kakhulu kunokutya okuthengwa kwiivenkile.
translation: All home-cooked food is much tastier than food bought in the shops.

sentence: Beka ukutya etafileni, abantwana sebelambile emva kokudlala ixesha elide.
translation: Put the food on the table; the children are hungry after playing for a long time.

sentence: Ukuzibulala yingxaki enkulu kulutsha, ngoko sifuna ukuthetha ngayo ezikolweni.
translation: Suicide is a serious problem among young people, so we want to talk about it in schools.

sentence: Abasebenzi bezempilo bathi ukuzibulala kunokuthintelwa xa umntu efumana uncedo ngexesha.
translation: Health workers say that suicide can be prevented when a person gets help in time.

sentence: Ulawulo lwesikolo lubhengeze ukuba iintlanganiso ziza kubanjwa ngoLwesine.
translation: The school management announced that the meetings will be held on Thursday.

sentence: Umama uphethe ulawulo lwemali yekhaya, uyibhala phantsi yonke inkcitho.
translation: Mom handles the household money, and she writes down every expense.

sentence: Emva kokulunywa yinyoka, uloyiko lwakhe lumenza angangeni egadini.
translation: After being bitten by a snake, his fear stops him going into the garden.

sentence: Ukuzilolonga rhoqo kunciphisa uloyiko lokuthetha phambi kwabantu abaninzi.
translation: Practising regularly reduces the fear of speaking in front of a lot of people.

sentence: Kule veki uluntu lwasekuhlaleni luqokelele imali yokwakha ibala labantwana.
translation: This week the local community collected money to build a playground for the children.

sentence: Oogqirha bacela uluntu ukuba lugonyise abantwana phambi kokuvulwa kwezikolo.
translation: Doctors are asking the public to have their children vaccinated before the schools open.

sentence: Umalusi uphethe uluthi olude xa eqhuba iigusha ezindulini.
translation: The herdsman carries a long stick when he drives the sheep on the hills.

sentence: Kule lali ulutsha lufuna indawo yokudlala ibhola kufuphi nekhaya.
translation: In this village the young people want a place to play soccer close to home.

sentence: Namhlanje ulutsha lusebenzisa iifowuni ukufunda izinto ezininzi ngokukhawuleza.
translation: Nowadays young people use phones to learn many things quickly.

sentence: Ulwaluko lubalulekile kwintsapho yethu, ngoko umkhuluwa wam uyaya ehlotyeni.
translation: Initiation matters a great deal in our family, so my older brother is going this summer.

sentence: Ngenyanga ezayo ulwaluko lwakhe luyaqala, yaye umama ulungiselela ukutya kwabantu.
translation: Next month his initiation begins, and Mum is getting the food ready for everyone.

sentence: Umbane uphinde wacima izolo ebusuku, salala singaphekanga ekhaya.
translation: The power went off again last night, and we went to bed without having cooked at home.

sentence: Abasebenzi basalungisa umbane emva kwesaqhwithi, ngoko sisebenzisa amakhandlela ngoku.
translation: The workers are still repairing the power supply after the storm, so we are using candles at the moment.

sentence: Izolo umbanjwa ukhutshwe ngebheyile emva kokuhlala iinyanga ezimbini entolongweni.
translation: Yesterday the prisoner was released on bail after two months in jail.

sentence: Intsapho yatyelela umbanjwa ngeCawa, yamphathela impahla nokutya okuthile.
translation: The family visited the prisoner on Sunday and brought him clothes and some food.

sentence: Umbuliso wakhe ufudumele, wandenza ndaziva ndamkelekile kuloo ndlu.
translation: His greeting was warm; it made me feel welcome in that house.

sentence: Ndathumela umbuliso kumakhulu ngefowuni kuba bendingenako ukuya ekhaya.
translation: I sent my grandmother a greeting by phone because I could not travel home.

sentence: EMthatha umbumbi ubumba imbiza enkulu yodongwe ngezandla zakhe zodwa.
translation: In Mthatha the potter shapes a large clay pot with his bare hands.

sentence: Abantwana bamemele umbumbi esikolweni ukuze abafundise ukwenza izitya zodongwe.
translation: The children invited the potter to the school so he could teach them to make clay dishes.

sentence: Ndiyavuma, umbuzo wakho ubalulekile, ngoko ke masiwuphendule kunye ngoku.
translation: I agree, your question is important, so let's answer it together now.

sentence: Umcimbi wamanzi elalini awukapheli, ngoko abahlali baya kudibana ngoLwesihlanu.
translation: The water problem in the village still isn't settled, so the residents are meeting on Friday.

sentence: Kule ntlanganiso kukho umcimbi omnye kuphela, yaye siza kuwugqiba ngokukhawuleza.
translation: There's only one item on the agenda at this meeting, and we'll get through it quickly.

sentence: Kwiinkolo ezininzi ehlabathini, umdali uyahlonitshwa kakhulu ngabantu.
translation: In many religions around the world, the creator is deeply honoured by people.

sentence: Umfula uzele emva kwemvula, ngoko abantwana abavumelekanga ukudlala ngaphaya.
translation: The river is full after the rain, so the children aren't allowed to play on the far side.

sentence: Ekuseni oomama bahamba umgama omde besiya kukha amanzi apho umfula ujika khona.
translation: In the morning the women walk a long way to fetch water where the river bends.

sentence: Egadini yam umfuno oluhlaza uyakhula ngokukhawuleza emva kwemvula enkulu.
translation: In my garden the green vegetable grows fast after heavy rain.

sentence: Umgama ophakathi kwekhaya lam nesikolo mde kakhulu.
translation: The distance between my home and my school is very long.

sentence: Sihambe umgama omde ngeenyawo phambi kokuba sifike elalini.
translation: We walked a long distance on foot before we reached the village.

sentence: Umgangatho wegumbi lokuhlala uyabanda ebusika, ngoko sithenge ikhaphethi entsha.
translation: The living-room floor is cold in winter, so we bought a new carpet.

sentence: Musa ukungena ngezihlangu ezimdaka, umgangatho usanda kucocwa ngumama.
translation: Don't come in with dirty shoes — the floor has just been cleaned by my mother.

sentence: Kusasa ndifumanise ukuba umgubo wesonka uphelile, ndicela uthenge omnye.
translation: This morning I found that the bread flour was finished; please buy some more.

sentence: Umama ugalela umgubo esityeni aze awuxube namanzi ashushu.
translation: Mother pours the flour into a bowl and then mixes it with hot water.

sentence: Kwafika umhambi ebusuku ecela indawo yokulala kwikhaya lethu.
translation: A traveller arrived at night asking for a place to sleep at our home.

sentence: Wadinwa umhambi lowo, wahlala phantsi ngasendleleni, wakhupha ibhotile yamanzi.
translation: That traveller got tired, sat down beside the road and took out a bottle of water.

sentence: Umakhulu uthi umhendi ufumana ithuba xa umntu engenamsebenzi wokwenza.
translation: Grandma says the tempter finds his chance when a person has nothing to do.

sentence: Kwibali lakhe, umhendi wayethetha ngelizwi elimnandi elalikhohlisa abantu bonke.
translation: In his story, the tempter spoke in a sweet voice that deceived everyone.

sentence: Namhlanje umhlana wam ubuhlungu emva kokuphakamisa ingxowa yombona izolo.
translation: My back is sore today after lifting a sack of maize yesterday.

sentence: Mama, ndikhuhlele umhlana ngesepha, andikwazi ukufikelela kuwo ngokwam.
translation: Mum, scrub my back with soap — I can't reach it myself.

sentence: Umhlathi wam ubuhlungu kakhulu emva kokutsalwa kwezinyo izolo ekliniki.
translation: My jaw is very sore after the tooth was pulled yesterday at the clinic.

sentence: Umakhulu utya kancinci kuba umhlathi wakhe awusasebenzi kakuhle njengakuqala.
translation: Grandmother eats little because her jaw no longer works as well as it used to.

sentence: Umakhulu ukha umhlonyane egadini xa umntwana ephethwe ngumkhuhlane.
translation: Grandmother picks wormwood in the garden when a child has come down with flu.

sentence: Umama ugalele umhluzi wenyama phezu kwerayisi yabantwana bam.
translation: Mother poured meat gravy over the rice for my children.

sentence: Le nyama ayimnandanga kuba umhluzi wayo uphekwe ngaphandle kwetyuwa.
translation: This meat isn't nice because its gravy was cooked without salt.

sentence: Umkhenkce unyibilike ngokukhawuleza elangeni, isiselo sethu sifudumele ngoku.
translation: The ice melted quickly in the sun; our drink is warm now.

sentence: Ndifake umkhenkce eglasini yakho ukuze amanzi abande ngaphambi kokutya.
translation: I've put ice in your glass so the water is cold before we eat.

sentence: Utatomkhulu uthi umkhonto wakhe ubukhali kakhulu, uwugcina kude nabantwana.
translation: Grandfather says his spear is very sharp, and he keeps it away from the children.

sentence: Kwimboniso yembali sibone umkhonto owasetyenziswa ngamadoda amandulo ekuzingeleni.
translation: At the history exhibition we saw a spear that men of old used for hunting.

sentence: Umqolomba osecaleni komlambo umnyama kwaye ubanda kakhulu.
translation: The cave beside the river is dark and very cold.

sentence: Ndiqaphele ukuba umqulu wam ushiyeke esikolweni, andikwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wasekhaya.
translation: I noticed that my file was left at school, so I can't do my homework.

sentence: Utitshala usinike umqulu omtsha apho sibhala khona amanqaku ethu.
translation: The teacher gave us a new file in which we write our marks.

sentence: Wonke umntu apha uwazi umsa katata kubantu abasokolayo.
translation: Everyone here knows my father's kindness towards people who are struggling.

sentence: Utata wemba umsele omde ukuze amanzi angangeni endlwini.
translation: Father dug a long ditch so that water wouldn't get into the house.

sentence: Umsesane womtshato kamama ulahlekile kwiveki ephelileyo, sisawukhangela namhlanje.
translation: Mother's wedding ring got lost last week, and we are still looking for it today.

sentence: Umfana undithengele umsesane omhle wesilivere ngosuku lwam lokuzalwa.
translation: The young man bought me a beautiful silver ring for my birthday.

sentence: Inja yam ishukumisa umsila wayo xa ndibuya emsebenzini.
translation: My dog wags its tail when I come home from work.

sentence: Umsonto omnyama uphelile, ngoko andikwazi ukuthunga le bhatyi yomntwana.
translation: The black thread is finished, so I cannot sew this child's jacket.

sentence: Umakhulu ufaka umsonto enalitini ngaphandle kweendondo, kodwa mna andikwazi.
translation: Grandmother threads the needle without glasses, but I cannot do it.

sentence: Ndibona ukuba umthamo wale ncwadi mninzi kakhulu kubafundi abaqalayo.
translation: I think the content of this book is far too much for beginners.

sentence: Utitshala uwunciphisile umthamo womsebenzi wekota, kuba ixesha lalifutshane kakhulu.
translation: The teacher cut down the amount of the term's work, because the time was too short.

sentence: Umthunzi womthi omkhulu upholile, masihlale phantsi kwawo.
translation: The shade of the big tree is cool; let us sit under it.

sentence: Ngexesha lasemini abalusi bafuna umthunzi ukuze bangatshiswa lilanga.
translation: At midday the herders look for shade so that the sun does not burn them.

sentence: Umtshakazi unxibe ilokhwe emhlophe, uhleka nabahlobo bakhe abasondeleyo.
translation: The bride is wearing a white dress, laughing with her close friends.

sentence: Oomama bacula ingoma yomtshato xa umtshakazi engena eholweni.
translation: The women sing a wedding song as the bride walks into the hall.

sentence: Umtya wesikhwama sam unqamkile, ngoko ndithwele iincwadi ngezandla.
translation: The strap of my bag has snapped, so I'm carrying my books in my hands.

sentence: Umalume usebenzisa umtya omde ukubopha ithole xa esenga unina.
translation: Uncle uses a long cord to tie the calf when he milks its mother.

sentence: Abasebenzi bendlela bamise umvalo omtsha apho kulungiswa khona ibhulorho.
translation: The road workers have put up a new barrier where the bridge is being repaired.

sentence: Inja yethu itsibe umvalo wegadi yaza yabaleka isiya esitalatweni.
translation: Our dog jumped the garden barrier and ran off towards the street.

sentence: Ngentwasahlobo silungisa umyezo, sityale imbewu yeetumato neminqathe.
translation: In spring we get the garden ready and plant tomato and carrot seed.

sentence: Umzamo wakhe wokufumana umsebenzi uthathe iinyanga ezintandathu, ekugqibeleni waphumelela.
translation: His effort to find work took six months, and in the end he succeeded.

sentence: Ndiyabulela ngawo wonke umzamo owenzileyo ukusinceda ngexesha lentlekele.
translation: Thank you for every effort you made to help us during the disaster.

sentence: Umzantsi welizwe unemimoya ebandayo ebusika, kodwa ihlobo lishushu kakhulu.
translation: The south of the country has cold winds in winter, but the summer is very hot.

sentence: Utata uthi umzantsi ushushu ngeKrisimesi, ngoko siza kutyelela usapho lwakhe.
translation: Dad says the south is hot at Christmas, so we're going to visit his family.

sentence: Utitshala usinike umzekelo ocacileyo phambi kokuba asiphe umsebenzi wasekhaya.
translation: The teacher gave us a clear example before giving us homework.

sentence: Ubawo usoloko esenza umzekelo omhle kubantwana bakhe ngokusebenza nzima.
translation: Father always sets a good example for his children by working hard.

sentence: Ndicela umzuzu wakho, ndifuna ukukubuza into ebalulekileyo malunga nomsebenzi.
translation: Can I have a minute of your time? I want to ask you something important about work.

sentence: Kwafika undwendwe lwethu emva kwesidlo sangokuhlwa, saza salubonisa indawo yokulala.
translation: Our guest arrived after supper, and we showed them where to sleep.

sentence: Xa undwendwe lufika ekhaya, silunika isitulo esihle nekomityi yetiye.
translation: When a guest arrives at our home, we give them a good chair and a cup of tea.

sentence: Wela umlambo ngebhulorho, mntwana, amanzi anamandla kakhulu namhlanje.
translation: Cross the river by the bridge, child — the water is very strong today.

sentence: Xa ibhulorho ivaliwe, wela ngesikhephe esikhulu esisecaleni kwevenkile.
translation: When the bridge is closed, cross on the big ferry next to the shop.

sentence: Ngenxa yomoya onamandla, wisa lo mthi ogobileyo phambi kokuba uwe phezu kwendlu.
translation: Because of the strong wind, fell this leaning tree before it falls on the house.

sentence: Ukuba ubona into engalunganga esikolweni, xela loo nto kutitshala omkhulu kwangoko.
translation: If you see something wrong at school, tell the principal straight away.

sentence: Sisi, xelela umama ukuba ndiza kufika emva kwentsimbi yesithandathu.
translation: Sis, tell Mom that I'll get there after six o'clock.

sentence: Xa ufika esikolweni, xelela utitshala ukuba ndigulile namhlanje.
translation: When you get to school, tell the teacher that I'm sick today.

sentence: NgoMgqibelo xhasa iqela lakho ebaleni, sonke siza kuhamba nawe.
translation: On Saturday support your team at the field; we'll all go with you.

sentence: Ngaphandle kwemali, xhasa abazali bakho ngokubancedisa ekhaya.
translation: Even without money, support your parents by helping them at home.

sentence: Ngomso ekuseni, xhela le gusha, size sipheke inyama ngokuhlwa.
translation: Tomorrow morning, slaughter this sheep so that we can cook the meat in the evening.

sentence: Bhuti, xhela inkukhu enye kuphela, asibaninzi namhlanje ekhaya.
translation: Brother, slaughter just one chicken — there aren't many of us at home today.

sentence: Ndikulumkisa okokugqibela, xoka kwakhona ndiza kuxelela utitshala wakho.
translation: I'm warning you for the last time — lie again and I'll tell your teacher.

sentence: Tata, yala abantwana bakho ngaphambi kokuba baye edolophini bodwa.
translation: Dad, warn your children before they go into town on their own.

sentence: Ezona zinto zibalulekileyo kule ndawo yimilambo emibini ehamba unyaka wonke.
translation: The most important things in this area are the two rivers that flow all year round.

sentence: Into eyenza esi sixeko sibe sihle yimilambo ehamba phakathi kwezakhiwo zaso.
translation: What makes this city beautiful is the rivers running between its buildings.

sentence: Ngomso zama ukufika kwangethuba, intlanganiso iqala ngentsimbi yesibhozo.
translation: Tomorrow try to arrive early; the meeting starts at eight o'clock.

sentence: Ukuba ifowuni yakho ayisebenzi, zama ukuyicima uze uyivule kwakhona.
translation: If your phone is not working, try switching it off and then on again.

sentence: Nceda zisa izitulo ezimbini kwigumbi lokutyela, kuba iindwendwe zifikile namhlanje.
translation: Please bring two chairs through to the dining room — the guests have arrived today.

sentence: Xa ubuya emsebenzini, zisa isonka nobisi, kuba akusekho nto ekhitshini.
translation: When you come back from work, bring bread and milk — there's nothing left in the kitchen.

sentence: Nantsi ipensile, zoba indlu yenu nomthi ophambi kwayo.
translation: Here's a pencil, draw your house and the tree in front of it.

sentence: Xa ugqibile ukubhala, zoba umgca omde phantsi kwegama lakho.
translation: When you've finished writing, draw a long line under your name.

sentence: Mfondini, zuza imali yakho ngokusebenza nzima, ungathembeli kubanye abantu.
translation: My man, earn your money by working hard; don't depend on other people.

sentence: Ngeeholide zasehlotyeni umkhozi wethu uyasityelela, uhlala eMonti nosapho lwakhe.
translation: In the summer holidays our in-law visits us; he lives in East London with his family.

sentence: Umama uthanda kakhulu umkhozi wakhe omtsha, bahleka kunye yonke imini.
translation: My mother is very fond of her new in-law; the two of them laugh together all day.

sentence: Umakhulu upheka umkhupha ngeCawa, siwutya nomhluzi wenkukhu oshushu.
translation: Grandmother cooks steamed bread on Sunday, and we eat it with hot chicken soup.

sentence: Umkhupha ushushu kakhulu, mntanam, linda imizuzu emihlanu phambi kokuba uwusike.
translation: The steamed bread is very hot, my child; wait five minutes before you cut it.

sentence: Emva kokubaleka ibanga elide izolo, umlenze wam uyaqaqamba namhlanje.
translation: After running a long distance yesterday, my leg is aching today.

sentence: Umfana wawa ebhayisikileni waza wonzakalisa kakubi umlenze wasekhohlo.
translation: The young man fell off the bicycle and badly injured his left leg.

sentence: Emarikeni ngeCawa, umlimi wethu wasekuhlaleni uthengisa iitapile ezintsha.
translation: At the market on Sundays, our local farmer sells fresh potatoes.

sentence: Kwiinyanga ezintathu ezidlulileyo, umlimi ulinde imvula engafikiyo.
translation: For the last three months the farmer has been waiting for rain that never comes.

sentence: Kwiminyaka emithathu edlulileyo, umlingane wam wasesikolweni wafudukela eKapa.
translation: Three years ago my friend from school moved to Cape Town.

sentence: Wonke umlingane wakhe wangena kwiqela lebhola, yena wasala ekhaya.
translation: Every one of his friends joined the soccer team, but he himself stayed home.

sentence: Kwintlanganiso yasekuhlaleni, umlisela wabuza imibuzo ebalulekileyo malunga nemisebenzi.
translation: At the community meeting, the young men asked important questions about jobs.

sentence: Utitshala usichazele ummangaliso wokukhanya kwenyanga phezu kolwandle ebusuku.
translation: The teacher explained to us the wonder of the moonlight on the sea at night.

sentence: Umakhulu usibalisela ummangaliso awubonileyo ngobusuku bokuwa kweenkwenkwezi eQonce.
translation: Grandmother tells us about the marvel she saw on the night of the falling stars in King William's Town.

sentence: Wonke ummi wale lali unelungelo lokusebenzisa amanzi omthombo.
translation: Every resident of this village has the right to use the spring water.

sentence: Ikomiti imemelela ummi ngamnye ukuba eze kwintlanganiso yangoMgqibelo.
translation: The committee calls on every resident to come to Saturday's meeting.

sentence: Namhlanje umoya umnandi, masitye isidlo sethu ngaphandle phantsi komthi.
translation: The weather is pleasant today; let's eat our meal outside under the tree.

sentence: Kukho umngxuma omkhulu endleleni eya esikolweni, ngoko ke qhuba ngononophelo.
translation: There is a big hole in the road to the school, so drive carefully.

sentence: Utata ugrumbe umngxuma wokutyala umthi weapile kwigadi yasemva.
translation: Dad dug a hole for planting the apple tree in the back garden.

sentence: Kwakhona, umnini wale ndlu unyuse irenti ngamakhulu amabini eerandi.
translation: Again, the owner of this house has raised the rent by two hundred rand.

sentence: Ndonzakele izolo, umnwe wam ubuhlungu, ngoko andikwazi ukubhala namhlanje.
translation: I hurt myself yesterday, my finger is sore, so I can't write today.

sentence: Umntwana omncinci ufake umnwe emlonyeni wakhe kwakhona.
translation: The little child has put his finger in his mouth again.

sentence: Emva kwemvula umnyama omhle ubonakele phezu kweentaba, bonke abantwana bakhwaza.
translation: After the rain a beautiful rainbow appeared over the mountains, and all the children shouted.

sentence: Umntwana ubuza ukuba umnyama unemibala emingaphi, andikwazi ukumphendula.
translation: The child is asking how many colours a rainbow has, and I can't answer him.

sentence: Wonakele umphambili wemoto yam emva kwengozi yayizolo.
translation: The front of my car was damaged after yesterday's accident.

sentence: Abasebenzi bapeyinte umphambili wesikolo ngombala omtsha kule veki.
translation: The workers painted the front of the school a new colour this week.

sentence: Sipeyinte umphandle wesakhiwo ngombala omhlophe, singekaqali ngaphakathi endlwini.
translation: We painted the outside of the building white, before we had even started inside the house.

sentence: Umphezulu wetafile yakhe ugcwele imifanekiso yosapho namakhandlela amabini.
translation: The top of her table is covered with family photos and two candles.

sentence: Uthuli lugquma umphezulu wekhabhathi, kuba asikhange sicoce iiveki ezimbini.
translation: Dust is covering the top of the cupboard, because we have not cleaned for two weeks.

sentence: Umqadi wophahla uqhekekile, kufuneka sibize umakhi phambi kokuba line.
translation: The roof beam has cracked; we need to call a builder before it rains.

sentence: Abasebenzi baphakamise umqadi omkhulu ngezandla zabo, kuba ayikho ikreyini.
translation: The workers lifted the big beam with their hands, because there was no crane.

sentence: Kule nkampani umqeshwa omtsha ufumana uqeqesho lweeveki ezimbini.
translation: At this company a new employee gets two weeks of training.

sentence: Umphathi uxelele umqeshwa wakhe ukuba angafiki emva kwexesha.
translation: The manager told his employee not to arrive late.

sentence: Emva komlilo, imithi yale ntaba iya kuba lusali iminyaka emininzi.
translation: After the fire, the trees on this mountain will be sparse for many years.

sentence: Utatomkhulu wayesithi, luza ngokunyaniseka, ungaqhathi, kuba impumelelo yobuqhetseba ayihlali.
translation: Grandfather used to say: lose honestly, don't cheat, because success built on trickery never lasts.

sentence: Ngenxa yenkungu yakusasa, umbono weentaba waba luzizi kakhulu.
translation: Because of the morning mist, the view of the mountains went very hazy.

sentence: Iinkumbulo zam zobuntwana ziye zaba luzizi ngokuhamba kwexesha.
translation: My childhood memories have grown faint with the passing of time.

sentence: Imozulu iye yaba mandundu ngokuhlwa, kwada kwanyanzeleka ukuba sibuyele ekhaya.
translation: The weather got worse towards evening, until we were forced to go back home.

sentence: Ukungezwani kwabamelwane kwaya kusiba mandundu de kwangenelela ikomiti yelali.
translation: The bad feeling between the neighbours kept getting worse until the village committee stepped in.

sentence: Hayi, waba masikizi loo mbono esiwubonileyo kwiindaba, abantwana bethu bothukile.
translation: That scene we saw on the news was ghastly; our children are shaken.

sentence: Umbono wendawo yengozi waba masikizi kangangokuba abanye bajika bemka.
translation: The sight of the accident scene was so ghastly that some people turned and left.

sentence: Emva kwemvula enkulu, indlela eya elalini yaba matye kakhulu.
translation: After the heavy rain, the road to the village became very stony.

sentence: Ngenxa yengqele, abantu baba mbalwa emsebenzini, sagqiba kwangexesha.
translation: Because of the cold, few people came to work, so we finished early.

sentence: Iinkukhu zethu ziba mbalwa minyaka le ngenxa yeempungutye.
translation: Our chickens get fewer every year because of the jackals.

sentence: Nokuba abanye abantu bayakugxeka, mela inyaniso ngamaxesha onke.
translation: Even if other people criticise you, stand for the truth at all times.

sentence: Kwintlanganiso yangomso, mela iqela lethu uchaze izikhalazo zabasebenzi.
translation: At tomorrow's meeting, represent our team and set out the workers' complaints.

sentence: Tata, misa imoto phambi kwesango, ndifuna ukuthatha iibhegi zam.
translation: Dad, stop the car in front of the gate; I want to fetch my bags.

sentence: Ukuba ubona into engalunganga, misa umsebenzi, uze uxelele umphathi.
translation: If you see something wrong, stop the work and tell the manager.

sentence: Mka endleleni, mntwana, iilori zidlula ngesantya esikhulu apha ekoneni.
translation: Get out of the road, child, the lorries go past at great speed here at the corner.

sentence: Xa imvula iqala, mka phantsi komthi ungene endlwini ngokukhawuleza.
translation: When the rain starts, get out from under the tree and go inside quickly.

sentence: Itheko likamakhulu laba mnandi, sonke sadlala sacula ubusuku bonke.
translation: Grandmother's party was lovely; we all played and sang the whole night.

sentence: Ndicela ufake ityuwa ukuze isuphu ibe mnandi kubantwana.
translation: Please add salt so the soup will taste good to the children.

sentence: Lo mntwana mncinane kakhulu, akanako ukuhamba yedwa esikolweni.
translation: This child is very small; he can't walk to school on his own.

sentence: Ewe, mncinane lo mthi endiwutyalileyo, kodwa uza kukhula ngokuhamba kwexesha.
translation: Yes, this tree I planted is small, but it will grow as time goes on.

sentence: Iimpahla zisenamanzi, ziba mvila xa ndizichukumisa ngesandla sam.
translation: The clothes are still wet; they feel damp when I touch them with my hand.

sentence: Phambi kokuba uhambe, ncamisa umakhulu wakho esidleleni sakhe.
translation: Before you go, kiss your grandmother on her cheek.

sentence: Emtshatweni, xa umfundisi egqiba ukuthetha, ncamisa inkosikazi yakho.
translation: At the wedding, when the minister finishes speaking, kiss your wife.

sentence: Kwiqonga, yiwa phantsi, ncwina kancinci, uze ubambe umlenze wakho.
translation: On stage, fall down, groan a little, and then hold your leg.

sentence: Xa uphakamisa into enzima kangaka, ncwina, sukuwubamba umphefumlo wakho.
translation: When you're lifting something that heavy, groan — don't hold your breath.

sentence: Umntwana ubaleke ngamendu esiya esikolweni kuba wayesele elibazisekile.
translation: The child ran fast on his way to school because he was already late.

sentence: Amanzi omlambo ahamba ngamendu emva kweemvula ezinkulu zangobusuku.
translation: The river water is running fast after the heavy rain in the night.

sentence: Ngcwaba loo ntaka ifileyo egadini, uze uhlambe izandla zakho emva koko.
translation: Bury that dead bird in the garden, and wash your hands afterwards.

sentence: Emva kokutya, ngcwaba amathambo enyama egadini ukuze izinja zingawafumani.
translation: After the meal, bury the meat bones in the garden so the dogs do not find them.

sentence: Ucango luvuliwe, ngena uhlale phantsi, ndiza kuza ngomzuzwana.
translation: The door is open, come in and sit down, I'll be there in a moment.

sentence: Musa ukuma emnyango, ngena endlwini ufudumale ngasesitovini.
translation: Don't stand in the doorway, come inside and warm yourself by the stove.

sentence: Kukho unwele olude esityeni sakho, ndicela usibuyisele ekhitshini.
translation: There's a long hair in your bowl; please take it back to the kitchen.

sentence: Umakhulu uthi unwele olumhlophe lokuqala lumbonisa ukuba uyaluphala.
translation: Grandma says her first grey hair shows her that she is growing old.

sentence: Kukho uphawu lwendlela olusixelela ukuba kufuneka sicothe apha esikolweni.
translation: There is a road sign telling us that we must slow down here at the school.

sentence: Wandibonisa uphawu olutsha lweshishini lakhe olubhalwe ngombala obomvu.
translation: He showed me the new sign for his business, written in red.

sentence: Urhwebo lwephondo lethu luxhomekeke kubulimi nakukhenketho, ngoko imbalela iyasothusa.
translation: Our province's trade depends on farming and tourism, so a drought frightens us.

sentence: Amazwe amabini atyikitye isivumelwano esitsha esiya kukhulisa urhwebo phakathi kwawo.
translation: The two countries signed a new agreement that will grow trade between them.

sentence: Ndibambe usana lwakhe ngeli xesha ekhupha izitshixo ebhegini.
translation: I held her baby while she took the keys out of the bag.

sentence: Usapho lwethu luhlangana rhoqo ngeKrisimesi kwikhaya likamakhulu elalini.
translation: Our family gathers every Christmas at grandmother's home in the village.

sentence: Usapho olukhulu lufuna indlu enkulu enamagumbi amaninzi okulala.
translation: A big family needs a large house with many bedrooms.

sentence: Ndafumana usiba lwentaka egadini, ndaza ndalubeka phezu kwetafile.
translation: I found a bird's feather in the garden and put it on the table.

sentence: Umntwana wadweba intaka enkulu, wongeza usiba olubomvu emsileni wayo.
translation: The child drew a big bird and added a red feather to its tail.

sentence: Ebusuku, usikrobana olusemnyango luvumela umoya obandayo ukuba ungene endlwini.
translation: At night the little gap at the door lets cold air come into the house.

sentence: Nangona ezama ukuncuma, usizi lwakhe lubonakala ebusweni bakhe.
translation: Even though he tries to smile, his sorrow shows on his face.

sentence: Emva kweenyanga ezintathu, usizi lwentsapho luthomalele kancinci kancinci.
translation: After three months, the family's grief has eased little by little.

sentence: Umalusi wathatha uswazi olude waqhuba iigusha ukuya edlelweni.
translation: The herdboy took a long switch and drove the sheep out to the pasture.

sentence: Sisebenzisa uswazi olu ukukhokela iinkomo, hayi ukubetha abantwana.
translation: We use this switch for guiding cattle, not for hitting children.

sentence: Uthango lwasemva lonakele, izinja ziyaphuma zisiya esitalatweni.
translation: The back fence is broken, so the dogs get out into the street.

sentence: Uvimba wasekhaya ugcwele ingqolowa nombona osanda kuvunwa kule veki.
translation: The storeroom at home is full of wheat and maize that has just been harvested this week.

sentence: Utata ulungise uvimba omtsha ngasemva kwendlu ukuze agcine imbewu yakhe.
translation: Father has fixed up a new storeroom behind the house so that he can keep his seed.

sentence: Sizobe uxande nesangqa kwiphepha lezibalo namhlanje ekuseni esikolweni.
translation: We drew a rectangle and a circle on the maths worksheet this morning at school.

sentence: Ndicela uzobe uxande kwiphepha lakho, uze ubhale ubude nobubanzi phantsi.
translation: Please draw a rectangle on your page, and then write the length and the width underneath.

sentence: Ndiyakucela, vela ngaphambi kwentsimbi yesihlanu ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba kunye.
translation: I'm asking you, show up before five o'clock so that we can leave together.

sentence: Umphathi wathi kubasebenzi: 'Bafana, vela kwakhona ngoLwesibini, siza kuqhuba umsebenzi.'
translation: The manager said to the workers: 'Lads, come again on Tuesday, we will carry on with the work.'

sentence: Xa ufika kwigumbi loviwo, velisa ikhadi lakho lomfundi.
translation: When you get to the exam room, produce your student card.

sentence: Ungathethi nje; velisa ubungqina bokuba wawukho ngobo busuku.
translation: Don't just talk; produce proof that you were there that night.

sentence: Ngoku ke, vuna umbona wonke phambi kokuba iintaka ziwutye.
translation: Right then, harvest all the maize before the birds eat it.

sentence: Ukuba uyaya emasimini namhlanje, vuna nemifuno yethu yonke.
translation: If you are going to the fields today, harvest all our vegetables as well.

sentence: Vuselela amandla akho ngokuphumla imizuzu elishumi phambi kokuba uqhube.
translation: Renew your strength by resting ten minutes before you drive.

sentence: Xa uziva udinwe kakhulu, vuselela umoya wakho ngokuhamba elwandle.
translation: When you feel very tired, renew your spirit by going down to the sea.

sentence: Yeka ukukhathazeka, vuya, umntwana wakho uphumelele kakuhle kwiimviwo.
translation: Stop worrying, be glad — your child passed the exams well.

sentence: Namhlanje sifumene indawo yokuhlala, ngoko ke vuya kunye nathi.
translation: Today we found a place to live, so be glad along with us.
